display_long_description:
Project Shadows is an immersive and thrilling gorilla tag-inspired multiplayer game where players leap, climb, and swing through a mysterious shadowy environment. Set in a world cloaked in perpetual twilight, the game combines fast-paced movement mechanics with a hauntingly beautiful atmosphere, encouraging both competitive gameplay and exploration.

Key Features:
Fluid Parkour Movement: Run, jump, and climb seamlessly as you navigate intricate environments full of hidden paths and secret areas.
Dynamic Shadow World: Explore a unique setting where dark forests, abandoned ruins, and glowing caves create a visually stunning yet eerie landscape.
Strategic Gameplay: Evade enemies, chase down opponents, and outsmart your friends in a variety of game modes like tag, hide-and-seek, and capture the orb.
Customizable Characters: Personalize your shadow creature with unique skins, glowing patterns, and accessories that match your style.
Social Multiplayer Experience: Join friends or meet new players in vibrant lobbies with proximity chat and cooperative mini-games.
Project Shadows combines the physical challenge of tag with a dark and enigmatic world where every movement counts, every shadow hides a secret, and every game tells a new story. Can you master the shadows?
